evidence_excerpts: The task scheduler uses a scheduling algorithm based on gradient descent to allocate resources to subgraphs that are more likely to improve end-to-end DNN performance.
For single-DNN latency, Ansor prioritizes a subgraph with high initial latency and leaves it after many iterations without latency decrease because its gradient decreases.
text: Ansor's task scheduler allocates tuning time to subgraphs that are most likely to improve end-to-end DNN performance.
